box-breathing-round-one: Let's begin. Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
box-breathing-round-two: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
box-breathing-round-three: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. If the hold feels long, let it go a little shorter.
box-breathing-round-four: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Last round.
legs-up-the-wall-breathe: Let your breath settle. Breathe in... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four... five... six.
barefoot-breathing-box: Let's begin. Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
slow-breaths-four-six: Breathe in... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four... five... six.
longer-out-breath-four-six: Same rhythm. Let the exhale come easy.
rest-box-breathing-settle: Breathe in... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four. Breathe out... two... three... four. Hold... two... three... four.
